name: Lover's Enigma
source:
You play as a young woman grappling with the aftermath of your fiancé's suspicious death, just weeks before your arranged marriage. Pressured by your controlling mother to move on and marry another suitor, you find yourself torn between familial duty and a relentless need for the truth. As you navigate tense family dynamics, uncover hidden secrets, and confront eerie supernatural occurrences, you must decide whether to follow the path laid out for you or forge your own destiny. Your choices will shape the narrative and determine the ultimate resolution of your fiancé's mysterious demise.

[From [url=https://fallencranberrystudio.itch.io/koibito-no-nazo-prologue]itch.io[/url]]
